note: Cooked food (Items refill 11): a roast keeps for cooked_life_mult times what the raw item had left (Tyler: 1.5 to 2.5 times, 3 at most), never more than the roast's own shelf life (spoilage.json), and a hot meal or drink adds the warms points to body warmth when eaten. raw_sick: eating these uncooked still feeds you but makes you sick for that many game hours (by item id or id suffix; raw meat 24, fiddleheads and beans 12, acorns and wild mushrooms a mild 6). Cooking placeholder (until the cook and food systems exist): at a lit fire, one raw forage item becomes Roasted forage (cooks_into maps others). A gathered item cooks when its id ends with one of the cookable words. Fire store (Dave 2026-10-22, F beside a fire): fire_slots slots for wood and food; wood in it feeds the fire when burn_left falls under feed_below_s seconds (or loads a cold fire), and one raw item cooks every box_cook_s seconds while it burns.
fuel_note: Every large log (log_<species>, carried on the shoulder, a pack item since 1 Nov 2026) burns like a log: 3 real hours. Dave 1 Nov 2026 (replaces the 24 Oct times): a stick burns 2 REAL minutes, a bolt of firewood 20 real minutes, a log 3 real hours (game seconds = real x 24; soft firewood half a firewood, kindling half a stick). Stored fuel is not capped (Dave 2 Nov 2026: the timer is the sum of all fuel). Older note: burn times in GAME seconds (clock is 24:1; a game hour is 2.5 real minutes), Dave 24 Oct: a stick, driftwood piece or bundle of kindling is a small fire's wood (stick 15 game minutes, driftwood 15, kindling 7.5), firewood 1 game hour (soft firewood 30 minutes), a log 2 game hours. A fire placed from a kit is laid with 4 sticks and lit by hand with plant fibre.
fire_tiers_note: A tier needs min_pieces PIECES laid on the fire, a soft firewood counting as much as a hard one (piece_game_s is the shortest piece of the class, only a ceiling by burning time). Dave 1 Nov 2026: medium (3+ firewood) is twice the small fire in light radius, brightness, warmth and protection from wolves; large (3+ logs) is twice the medium again (light_m 3.5/7/14, light_energy 1/2/4 (set to match the client FIRE_LIGHT, docs and CONTROLS on 2 Nov 2026; the server does not read them for fires), heat_c 10/20/40 within heat_radius_m, protect_m 5/10/20 = how far wolves keep from it). The heat reach is not doubled. Dave 24 Oct: one campfire whose size follows its wood. The fire burns its biggest wood first. A tier needs at least min_pieces pieces of that wood; once burning it stays that size until that wood is gone, then drops to the highest tier that still has min_pieces, else the survival fire. Tier 1 survival (sticks, driftwood, kindling), 2 campfire (firewood), 3 bonfire (logs). state is the world-item state of a lit fire of that tier (1 stays the campfire; 40 and 41 are new and only appended). light_m and light_energy size the client light, heat_c and heat_radius_m the warmth.

rain_light_chance.note: Lighting a fire in light rain (under puts_out strength) can fail: chance = max(min_chance, 1 - rain / puts_out x loss). The tinder is used either way.

coals.note: After the flames (docs/design/fire_coals_design.md, coordinator decision 8 Nov 2026, Dave may revert). A fire that burned coal_bed_s real seconds in all since it was last cold burns out to coals (state 76) for coals_s, then warm ash (77) for ash_s, then cold ash (8); a shorter fire goes straight to cold ash. Wood laid on coals catches by itself after catch_s by its biggest class. Rain of 0.2 or more on uncovered coals turns them to warm ash after rain_s, and the ash goes cold after a further ash_rain_s. Wood plus a tinder item (tinder, tinder_also) lights warm ash with no damp roll and uses the tinder up. Coals warm heat_c within heat_m and do not keep wolves off. All times are real seconds.
coals.rain_note: Step 2: a large fire (state 41) with a coal bed is not put out by rain of any strength; while the rain is rain_burn_from or more it burns rain_burn_x faster, and in any rain it sends smoke 1 on its row. Small and medium fires go out in rain as before.

wet_wood.note: Wet wood (docs/design/fire_coals_design.md 5, step 3; coordinator decision 8 Nov 2026, Dave may revert). A wood item's slot wear is its drying left in tenths of a game hour (0 = dry). Rain of rain_from or more wets loose wood lying uncovered and the wood of an unlit uncovered fire up to its class's wet_h; a pack and a chest keep wood dry. Wood dries 1 game hour per game hour out of the rain, fire_dry_x times as fast in a lit fire's store or within its heat reach. Fresh-cut wood is dry. A lit fire holding wet wood burns wet_burn_x as long, a tier lower in heat and light, and smokes; a laid fire whose kindling is all wet lights at light_x of the usual chance unless dry tinder is in it. Stacks join only within wet_merge_h of drying left and keep the wetter. Checked every tick_s real seconds.
